sow.scope_of_work: The specific scope of work, services, and tasks to be executed.
sow.payment_milestones: Payment milestones tied to completion percentages or financial deliverables.
sow.deliverables: The final outputs and deliverables expected to be received from the project.
sow.acceptance_criteria: Technical acceptance and inspection criteria required to approve the work.
sow.service_level_agreements: Service Level Agreements (SLA), performance metrics, and delay penalties.

nda.definition_of_confidential_information: Definition of confidential information and exchanged data covered under protection.
nda.confidentiality_period: The period or duration of non-disclosure and confidentiality obligations after contract termination.
nda.permitted_disclosure_exceptions: Exceptions to non-disclosure permitted by law or explicitly excluded from confidentiality.
nda.return_or_destruction_of_data: The technical and legal return or destruction of confidential data and files upon termination.

supply.product_specifications: Technical product specifications, characteristics, and quality standards required for the goods.
supply.delivery_schedules: Delivery schedules, shipping timelines, and transport methods specified over time.
supply.minimum_order_quantity: The Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) mandatory to purchase per shipment or period.
supply.inspection_and_rejection_rights: Inspection and testing rights upon receipt and the authority to reject non-compliant goods.

risk_analysis_rules.description: Limitation of liability, financial liability caps, damage ceiling, and exclusion of indirect damages.
Contractual payment terms, payment deadlines, net payment days, and invoice settlement timelines.
Automatic contract renewal, renewal terms, evergreen clauses, extension options, and notice periods for non-renewal.
